rules.title: Alabama — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

result.summary: Alabama has no final paycheck statute; under the FLSA wages are due on the next regular payday for the last pay period.

citations.source: 29 CFR §778.106 (FLSA: wages due on the regular payday)

rules.title: Florida — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

result.summary: Florida has no final paycheck statute; under the FLSA wages are due on the next regular payday for the last pay period.

citations.source: 29 CFR §778.106 (FLSA: wages due on the regular payday)

rules.title: Georgia — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

result.summary: Georgia has no final paycheck statute; under the FLSA wages are due on the next regular payday for the last pay period.

citations.source: 29 CFR §778.106 (FLSA: wages due on the regular payday)

rules.title: Mississippi — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

result.summary: Mississippi has no final paycheck statute; under the FLSA wages are due on the next regular payday for the last pay period.

citations.source: 29 CFR §778.106 (FLSA: wages due on the regular payday)

rules.title: Alaska — Final Wages on Discharge

result.summary: Wages due within 3 working days after termination by the employer.

rules.title: Alaska — Final Wages on Resignation

params.notice_shortens_deadline: next regular payday that is at least 3 days after the employee gives notice of quitting

result.summary: Wages due on the next regular payday at least 3 days after the employee's notice of quitting.

rules.title: Arizona — Final Wages on Discharge

result.summary: Discharged employees must be paid within 7 working days or by the next regular payday, whichever is sooner.

rules.title: Arizona — Final Wages on Resignation

result.summary: Employees who quit are paid no later than the next regular payday.

rules.title: Arkansas — Final Wages on Discharge

params.penalty: double wages if unpaid within 7 days after the next regular payday following written demand

result.summary: Discharged employees (of corporations) are paid by the next regular payday; failure within 7 days of demand doubles the wages owed.

citations.source: 29 CFR §778.106 (FLSA: wages due on the regular payday)

rules.title: Arkansas — Final Wages on Resignation

result.summary: Arkansas has no deadline for employees who quit; FLSA next-regular-payday practice applies.

citations.source: 29 CFR §778.106 (FLSA: wages due on the regular payday)

rules.title: California — Final Wages on Discharge

params.penalty: waiting time penalty of one day's wages per day late, up to 30 days (§203)

result.summary: All wages are due immediately on discharge or layoff; late payment accrues a waiting time penalty of a day's pay per day up to 30 days.

rules.title: California — Final Wages on Resignation

params.notice_shortens_deadline: due on the last day if the employee gave at least 72 hours' notice
params.penalty: waiting time penalty of one day's wages per day late, up to 30 days (§203)

result.summary: Employees who quit without 72 hours' notice are paid within 72 hours; with 72 hours' notice, on the last day.

rules.title: Colorado — Final Wages on Discharge

params.notice_shortens_deadline: if the payroll unit is not regularly scheduled to operate, within 6 hours after its next workday starts (24 hours if off-site)
params.penalty: up to 2x wages or 10 days' wages after written demand

result.summary: Wages due immediately on discharge; if the payroll unit is closed, within 6 hours after the start of its next workday (24 hours if payroll is off-site).

rules.title: Colorado — Final Wages on Resignation

result.summary: Employees who quit are paid on the next regular payday.

rules.title: Connecticut — Final Wages on Discharge

params.notice_shortens_deadline: laid-off employees are paid by the next regular payday

result.summary: Discharged employees are paid no later than the next business day; laid-off employees by the next regular payday.

rules.title: Connecticut — Final Wages on Resignation

result.summary: Employees who quit are paid by the next regular payday.

rules.title: Delaware — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

params.notice_shortens_deadline: if later, 3 days after the last day of the pay period in which separation occurred

result.summary: All wages are due by the next regular payday (or within 3 days after the end of the pay period of separation, if later), payable by mail on request.

rules.title: District of Columbia — Final Wages on Discharge

params.notice_shortens_deadline: 4 days when the employee was responsible for the employer's money
params.penalty: 10% of unpaid wages per working day, up to the amount owed

result.summary: Discharged employees are paid no later than the next working day (4 days if they handled the employer's money).

rules.title: District of Columbia — Final Wages on Resignation

result.summary: Employees who quit are paid by the next regular payday or within 7 days, whichever is earlier.

rules.title: Hawaii — Final Wages on Discharge

params.notice_shortens_deadline: by the next working day if immediate payment is not possible

result.summary: Discharged employees are paid in full at the time of discharge, or by the next working day when immediate payment is impossible.

rules.title: Hawaii — Final Wages on Resignation

params.notice_shortens_deadline: on the last day if the employee gave at least one pay period's notice

result.summary: Employees who quit are paid by the next regular payday, or on the last day if they gave one pay period's notice.

rules.title: Idaho — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

params.notice_shortens_deadline: within 48 hours (excluding weekends and holidays) of a written request for earlier payment

result.summary: Final wages are due by the next regular payday or within 10 business days, whichever is earlier; within 48 hours after a written request.

rules.title: Illinois — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

params.notice_shortens_deadline: at the time of separation if possible

result.summary: Final compensation, including earned vacation, is paid at separation if possible and in no case later than the next regular payday.

rules.title: Indiana — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

params.notice_shortens_deadline: if the employee's address is unknown, within 10 days after demand

result.summary: Final wages are due on the next regular payday (within 10 days of demand when the employee's whereabouts are unknown).

rules.title: Iowa — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

result.summary: Final wages are due by the next regular payday.

rules.title: Kansas — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

result.summary: Final wages are due by the next regular payday.

rules.title: Kentucky — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

result.summary: Final wages are due by the next regular payday or within 14 days of separation, whichever is later.

rules.title: Louisiana — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

params.penalty: up to 90 days' wages for failure after demand (R.S. 23:632)

result.summary: Final wages are due by the next regular payday or within 15 days of separation, whichever is earlier.

rules.title: Maine — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

result.summary: Final wages, including vacation for employers with 11+ employees, are due by the next regular payday or within 2 weeks of demand, whichever is earlier.

rules.title: Maryland — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

result.summary: All wages due for work before separation are paid by the day the employee would have been paid had they not left.

rules.title: Massachusetts — Final Wages on Discharge

params.penalty: mandatory treble damages for late payment (c.149 §150)

result.summary: Discharged employees must be paid in full, including earned vacation, on the day of discharge; late payment carries mandatory treble damages.

rules.title: Massachusetts — Final Wages on Resignation

params.notice_shortens_deadline: if there is no regular payday, by the Saturday after quitting

result.summary: Employees who quit are paid in full on the next regular payday (or the following Saturday if there is none).

rules.title: Michigan — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

params.notice_shortens_deadline: as soon as the amount can be determined with due diligence; hand harvesters within 3 days

result.summary: Final wages are due as soon as the amount can be determined with due diligence, and no later than the regularly scheduled payday.

rules.title: Minnesota — Final Wages on Discharge

params.penalty: average daily wage for each day late, up to 15 days

result.summary: Discharged employees must be paid within 24 hours of demand; the penalty is a day's wages per day late up to 15 days.

rules.title: Minnesota — Final Wages on Resignation

params.notice_shortens_deadline: if the next payday is within 5 days of the last day, the following payday, but no more than 20 days after the last day

result.summary: Employees who quit are paid by the next regular payday at least 5 days after the last day, and in no case more than 20 days after.

rules.title: Missouri — Final Wages on Discharge

params.penalty: wages continue up to 60 days after written request

result.summary: Discharged employees (of corporations) are paid all wages due on the day of discharge; on written request, unpaid wages continue as a penalty for up to 60 days.

citations.source: 29 CFR §778.106 (FLSA: wages due on the regular payday)

rules.title: Missouri — Final Wages on Resignation

result.summary: Missouri sets no deadline for employees who quit; FLSA next-regular-payday practice applies.

citations.source: 29 CFR §778.106 (FLSA: wages due on the regular payday)

rules.title: Montana — Final Wages on Discharge

params.notice_shortens_deadline: a written personnel policy may extend the deadline to the next regular payday or 15 days, whichever is earlier

result.summary: Discharged employees are paid immediately unless a written policy extends the deadline to the earlier of the next regular payday or 15 days.

rules.title: Montana — Final Wages on Resignation

result.summary: Employees who quit are paid by the next regular payday or within 15 days, whichever is earlier.

rules.title: Nebraska — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

result.summary: Final wages are due by the next regular payday or within 2 weeks of separation, whichever is sooner.

rules.title: Nevada — Final Wages on Discharge

params.penalty: wages continue up to 30 days if not paid within 3 days (§608.040)

result.summary: Discharged employees are paid immediately; wages continue as a penalty for up to 30 days if not paid within 3 days.

rules.title: Nevada — Final Wages on Resignation

result.summary: Employees who quit are paid by the next regular payday or within 7 days, whichever is earlier.

rules.title: New Hampshire — Final Wages on Discharge

result.summary: Discharged employees are paid within 72 hours of discharge.

rules.title: New Hampshire — Final Wages on Resignation

params.notice_shortens_deadline: within 72 hours of the last day if the employee gave at least one pay period's notice

result.summary: Employees who quit are paid by the next regular payday, or within 72 hours if they gave one pay period's notice.

rules.title: New Jersey — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

result.summary: Final wages are due by the next regular payday.

rules.title: New Mexico — Final Wages on Discharge

params.notice_shortens_deadline: 10 days when wages are task, piece or commission based

result.summary: Discharged employees are paid fixed wages within 5 days (10 days for commission, piece or task pay).

rules.title: New Mexico — Final Wages on Resignation

result.summary: Employees who quit are paid by the next regular payday.

rules.title: New York — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

result.summary: Final wages are due by the next regular payday, by mail on request.

rules.title: North Carolina — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

params.notice_shortens_deadline: commissions and bonuses on the first payday after the amount can be calculated

result.summary: Final wages are due on or before the next regular payday; bonuses and commissions once calculable.

rules.title: North Dakota — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

result.summary: Final wages are due by the next regular payday, by certified mail on request.

rules.title: Ohio — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

result.summary: Final wages follow the semimonthly schedule of §4113.15: by the 1st for wages earned in the first half of the prior month and the 15th for the second half, which is no later than the next regular payday or 15 days.

rules.title: Oklahoma — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

result.summary: Final wages are due by the next regular payday, by mail on request.

rules.title: Oregon — Final Wages on Discharge

params.penalty: up to 30 days' wages at 8 hours a day for willful late payment (§652.150)

result.summary: Discharged employees are paid by the end of the next business day; willful late payment accrues up to 30 days of penalty wages.

rules.title: Oregon — Final Wages on Resignation

params.notice_shortens_deadline: on the last day if the employee gave at least 48 hours' notice (excluding weekends and holidays)

result.summary: Employees who quit without 48 hours' notice are paid within 5 business days or by the next regular payday, whichever is first; with 48 hours' notice, on the last day.

rules.title: Pennsylvania — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

result.summary: Final wages are due by the next regular payday, by certified mail on request.

rules.title: Rhode Island — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

params.notice_shortens_deadline: within 24 hours when the business is liquidated, merged, sold or moved out of state

result.summary: Final wages (including vacation after one year of service) are due on the next regular payday; within 24 hours if the business closes, is sold or relocates out of state.

rules.title: South Carolina — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

params.notice_shortens_deadline: or by the next regular payday, not to exceed 30 days

result.summary: Final wages are due within 48 hours of separation or by the next regular payday, not to exceed 30 days.

rules.title: South Dakota — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

params.notice_shortens_deadline: payment may be withheld until the employee returns employer property

result.summary: Final wages are due by the next regular payday, or as soon after as the employee returns the employer's property.

rules.title: Tennessee — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

result.summary: Final wages are due by the next regular payday or within 21 days, whichever is later (employers with 5+ employees).

rules.title: Texas — Final Wages on Discharge

result.summary: Discharged employees are paid in full within 6 calendar days.

rules.title: Texas — Final Wages on Resignation

result.summary: Employees who quit are paid by the next regularly scheduled payday.

rules.title: Utah — Final Wages on Discharge

params.penalty: wages continue up to 60 days after written demand

result.summary: Discharged employees are paid within 24 hours; unpaid wages continue as a penalty for up to 60 days after written demand.

rules.title: Utah — Final Wages on Resignation

result.summary: Employees who quit are paid by the next regular payday.

rules.title: Vermont — Final Wages on Discharge

result.summary: Discharged employees are paid within 72 hours of discharge.

rules.title: Vermont — Final Wages on Resignation

params.notice_shortens_deadline: if there is no regular payday, the following Friday

result.summary: Employees who quit are paid on the last regular payday, or the following Friday if there is none.

rules.title: Virginia — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

result.summary: Final wages are due on or before the date the employee would have been paid had they not separated.

rules.title: Washington — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

result.summary: Final wages are due by the end of the established pay period (the next regular payday).

rules.title: West Virginia — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

params.notice_shortens_deadline: replacement cost of unreturned employer property may be withheld in limited circumstances

result.summary: Final wages are due on or before the next regular payday (changed from 72 hours in 2015); liquidated damages of twice the unpaid wages apply.

rules.title: Wisconsin — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

params.notice_shortens_deadline: within 24 hours when the business merges, liquidates, relocates or ceases operations

result.summary: Final wages are due by the next regular payday (no later than 31 days after the pay period ends); within 24 hours on a business closing, sale or relocation.

rules.title: Wyoming — Final Wages on Discharge Or Resignation

result.summary: Final wages are due by the next regular payday (since 2013, previously 5 working days).
